product_output_contract.user_need: 以Founder意圖與人類可見產品效果先建立完整8D狀態場，再從每個檔案的內容契約分析需求、供給、作用、依賴與關係，形成完整ADI座標並重構檔案應有名稱與作用。
product_output_contract.product_outcome: 一組不依賴Git、以來源內容供需契約形成、候選限定、SHA綁定且比較子程序隔離的8D／ADI系統設計意圖場。
deliverables: per-file atomic 8D and full ADI state nodes
complete causal edge records with explicit UNKNOWN fields
reconstructed logical filename and intended role
product_output_contract.interface_behavior: 接收Founder意圖與人類可見產品效果後，本機直接分析或透過私有固定IP設定以一般SSH載送分析器；任何失敗均關閉並回傳單一PRECONDITION_MISSING，不搜尋替代節點。
quality_thresholds: all comparator processes bind the identical snapshot and pair-plan hashes
bounded source content contracts rather than path-token or Git semantics
technology identity evidence preserves all six fixed axes and EV evidence levels
effect equivalence remains separate from technical equivalence and no weighted identity score is emitted
no semantic, fuzzy, embedding, Git, or post-freeze source search
no raw protected source content retained
symbolic links and protected directories are never followed
read and directory-enumeration failures remain explicit coverage gaps
acceptance_criteria: all declared JSON and JSONL artifacts parse
every edge endpoint exists in the frozen snapshot
every edge contains the complete causal contract and explicit content supply-demand evidence when reconstructed
all eleven child comparator execution receipts bind identical snapshot and pair-plan hashes
technology identity evidence remains gate-input-only with local decision NOT_RUN and unsupported axes explicit
structured red-team evidence is covered by the output SHA-256 manifest
SHA-256 manifest covers every output except itself
Git is not consulted and source repository remains unchanged
runtime fixed-IP operation requires separate evidence
product_output_contract.failure_behavior: 以PRECONDITION_MISSING或HOLD_TRUE_HARD_RISK停止；不降級、不猜測、不切換節點、不產生PASS。
prohibited_outputs: raw credential, identity plaintext, or cloud dialogue plaintext
complete-source claim when read or directory-enumeration gaps exist
private IP or SSH account in shared artifacts
claim that SSH is W7TP generative transmission
weighted technology-identity score or local technical-sameness decision
patentability, legal, or global-superiority inference from repository evidence
allowed_side_effects: write bounded reversible candidate evidence under the explicit output directory

protected_representation: bounded content-contract features without full source retention

D1.name: INTENT
D1.contract: 解析Founder需求、可見產物與每一檔案存在目的；推論必須標成候選。

D2.name: STATE
D2.contract: 定位目前來源、內容宣告、狀態轉移、候選／runtime狀態、衝突與未知，不以Git定義狀態。

D3.name: COORDINATE
D3.contract: 綁定不洩漏私有網路資訊的節點、目前路徑、時間與命名空間座標。

D4.name: EVIDENCE
D4.contract: 保存內容SHA、解析狀態、凍結索引、供需pair plan、輸出SHA，以及六軸技術身分 gate-input 與 EV0-EV5 證據。

D5.name: EXECUTION_POLICY
D5.contract: 只允許唯讀來源分析與明示輸出目錄的可逆候選寫入；比較器獨立且不可重搜。

D6.name: GENERATIVE_TRANSMISSION
D6.contract: 本技能不宣稱生成式傳輸；固定IP SSH只是載體，8D／ADI重構條件保持候選；載體、重構與驗證證據必須分離。

D7.name: RED_TEAM_RISK_CONFINEMENT
D7.contract: 敏感來源不讀不雜湊不輸出；任何來源寫入、權威漂移、私有座標洩漏、效果等同誤作技術同一、六軸缺漏、加權分數或專利推論均停止。

D8.name: ENVELOPE_AUTHORITY
D8.contract: 身分封包與Active Seat決定可用範圍；LLM、ADI、比較器與SSH皆無最終裁決權。

dependencies: OpenSSH client for optional remote carrier
Founder intent and human-visible product-effect input
w7tp.technology-identity-audit@1.0.0 when a technology identity claim is in scope
execution_contract.rollback: Remove only the exact newly created candidate output directory after verifying it is not a source, canonical, runtime, database, or pre-existing evidence coordinate.

product_acceptance_checks: one Founder intent field root and one freeze with per-enumerated-path content-contract nodes
complete edge-contract fields and explicit reconstructed supply-demand separation from Total Field verification
six-axis technology-identity evidence remains gate-input-only and retains unsupported axes
structured three-stage red-team evidence bound into the output manifest
static_checks: Total Field skill manifest schema validation
runtime_checks: six-axis evidence artifact self-test with weighted score forbidden
separate fixed-IP carrier evidence before any runtime claim
evidence_required: six-axis technology identity evidence candidate SHA

suspension_triggers: path, time, hash, or keyword promoted to design causation
technology identity evidence axis omission or weighted-score introduction
effect equivalence, shared carrier, or repository shape promoted to technical identity
source coverage gap hidden or promoted to complete
identity seat or access profile change
